plain: The main difference is in what direction they process context and what task they're built for. An encoder-only transformer, like BERT, uses bidirectional attention, meaning each token can attend to every other token in the input, both before and after it, which makes it well-suited for understanding tasks like classification, sentiment analysis, or filling in masked words. A decoder-only transformer, like GPT models, uses causal (unidirectional) attention, where each token can only attend to previous tokens, which makes it naturally suited for generating text one token at a time, since it can't "see" what comes next.
